desc:
Welcome to Project Egoist!

🖥️ PC Control :
Q - Dribble
E - Steal / SideDash
R - Super Dash
T - Request Ball
F - Flow State Awaken
M1 - Shoot Ball
M2 - Pass Ball
Z, X, C, V - Skills
Ctrl - Run

🎮 Console Control : 
Press Left Stick (L3) - Run
Y / Triangle (△) - Super Dash
X / Square (□) - Dribble
B / Circle (○) - Steal
RT / R2 -Shoot Ball
LT / L2 - Pass Ball / Request Ball
LB / L1 - Skill1
RB / R1 - Skill2
D-Pad Down - Flow State Awaken (Hold for Emote)
D-Pad Left - Skill3
D-Pad Right - Skill4
D-Pad Up - Shiftlock


⚙️You can change keybinds as well as Mobile Buttons in settings!

Special Thanks to D.Meletis for OST!
